newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Colombian peso ends slightly lower at 1,036.30.
newsitem.headline: Colombian peso ends slightly lower at 1,036.30.

text.p: Colombia's peso closed slightly lower, at 1,036.30 to the dollar, in dull trading on the country's interbank market, dealers said.
"The market didn't move at all," one dealer said in a telephone interview. "There was no supply and no demand, just a few operations with clients for small amounts."
Dealers reported a lower-than-average total of trades for just $67.7 million and said the peso, which fell 35 centavos from Thursday's close, held in a narrow 1,035 to 1,036.65 range.
